results.question: Which suppliers have never been sent a purchase order?
results.raw_reply:
SELECT s.name
FROM suppliers s
LEFT JOIN purchase_orders po ON s.company_id = po.company_id
WHERE po.id IS NULL;

results.question: List the PO numbers of purchase orders that have not been invoiced yet.
results.raw_reply: SELECT po_number FROM purchase_orders WHERE po_id NOT IN (SELECT po_id FROM supplier_invoices);
results.extracted_sql: SELECT po_number FROM purchase_orders WHERE po_id NOT IN (SELECT po_id FROM supplier_invoices);

results.question: Show each supplier's name and total purchase order value, highest first.
results.raw_reply:
SELECT s.name, SUM(p.total_amount) AS total_purchase_order_value
FROM suppliers s
JOIN purchase_orders p ON s.company_id = p.company_id
GROUP BY s.name
ORDER BY total_purchase_order_value DESC;
results.extracted_sql:
SELECT s.name, SUM(p.total_amount) AS total_purchase_order_value
FROM suppliers s
JOIN purchase_orders p ON s.company_id = p.company_id
GROUP BY s.name
ORDER BY total_purchase_order_value DESC;

results.question: For each supplier, how many deliveries arrived after the expected date? Highest first.
results.raw_reply:
SELECT s.name, COUNT(DISTINCT g.received_by) AS deliveries_after_expected_date
FROM suppliers s
JOIN purchase_orders po ON s.company_id = po.company_id
JOIN goods_receipts g ON po.id = g.po_id
WHERE g.received_by IS NOT NULL
AND g.received_by > po.expected_date
GROUP BY s.name
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT g.received_by) DESC;
results.extracted_sql:
SELECT s.name, COUNT(DISTINCT g.received_by) AS deliveries_after_expected_date
FROM suppliers s
JOIN purchase_orders po ON s.company_id = po.company_id
JOIN goods_receipts g ON po.id = g.po_id
WHERE g.received_by IS NOT NULL
AND g.received_by > po.expected_date
GROUP BY s.name
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT g.received_by) DESC;

results.question: List the PO numbers of orders received exactly 3 days after the expected date.
results.extracted_sql: SELECT po_number FROM purchase_orders WHERE receipt_date = DATE('now', '-3 days') AND status = 'Received';

results.question: List the supplier name and invoice number for every invoice not paid in full.
results.raw_reply:
SELECT s.name, si.invoice_number
FROM suppliers s
JOIN supplier_invoices si ON s.company_id = si.company_id
WHERE si.amount_paid < si.total_amount;
